##### Project general facts

Enaya Residences is a masterful creation where luxury and comfort converge in perfect harmony, boasting exquisitely crafted apartments with one and two-bedroom layouts, each adorned with an array of luxurious amenities and finishes that epitomize refinement and sophistication. As residents step into their Enaya Residence, they are enveloped in a sense of warmth and comfort, with every detail meticulously designed to enhance their living experience, from the spacious living areas to the tranquil bedrooms. The apartments are thoughtfully laid out to maximize space and functionality, ensuring that every aspect of the living area is designed with the resident's comfort in mind, whether entertaining guests or unwinding in the serene ambiance of their personal space.

The residences at Enaya Residences are supported by a range of lavish amenities, including elegant kitchens and bathrooms that feature high-end fixtures and appliances, offering a perfect blend of style and functionality. The commitment to quality is reflected in every aspect of the building's design and construction, ensuring that residents enjoy a living experience that is truly exceptional. With a focus on creating a premium living environment, the materials and finishes used in Enaya Residences have been carefully selected to provide a sophisticated and elegant atmosphere, perfect for discerning residents who appreciate the finer things in life.

The interior of Enaya Residences features modern finishing with high-quality materials, beautifully crafted to provide a sense of luxury and comfort. The kitchens are equipped with high-end appliances and fixtures, while the bathrooms exude elegance and sophistication, creating a perfect sanctuary for relaxation and rejuvenation. Every detail, from the flooring to the lighting, has been carefully considered to provide a living space that is both functional and beautiful, making Enaya Residences the ultimate retreat for those seeking a luxurious and comfortable lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a tranquil and vibrant community that offers a unique blend of natural beauty and urban convenience. The area is surrounded by lush green spaces, including parks, jogging and cycling tracks, and walking paths, providing residents with ample opportunities to engage in outdoor activities and enjoy the fresh air. Jumeirah Village Circle boasts a range of community amenities, including retail outlets, supermarkets, and dining options, ensuring that residents have easy access to daily necessities and can enjoy a convenient and comfortable lifestyle.

Residents of Jumeirah Village Circle benefit from the area's strong emphasis on community living and family-friendly amenities, with a range of services and facilities designed to cater to their needs. The community has its own international school, making it an ideal choice for families with school-age children, and the abundance of green spaces and outdoor recreational areas provides a peaceful retreat from the bustling city. The area's tranquil ambiance and natural beauty make it the perfect location for those seeking a relaxed and peaceful lifestyle, while its convenient amenities and services ensure that residents have everything they need at their fingertips.

Jumeirah Village Circle is characterized by its unique blend of natural beauty and urban convenience, with its lush green spaces and community amenities creating a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere. The area's retail outlets, supermarkets, and dining options provide residents with a range of choices and convenience, while its international school and community facilities make it an ideal choice for families. With its tranquil ambiance and natural beauty, Jumeirah Village Circle is the perfect location for those seeking a relaxed and peaceful lifestyle, surrounded by the beauty and amenities of a vibrant community.
